p: are open hath said: His eyes were shut up before in respect to the clear visions which he saw after.
falling into a trance: Though he lay as in a sleep, yet the eyes of his mind were open.
water out of his buckets: His prosperity and posterity will be very great.
Agag: Which name was common to the kings of Amalek.
smote his hands together: In token of anger.
LORD hath kept thee back from: Thus the wicked burden God when they cannot carry out their wicked enterprises.
advertise thee what this people shall: He gave also wicked counsel to cause the Israelites to sin, that God might forsake them, Nu 31:16.
Star out of Jacob: Meaning Christ.
corners of Moab: That is, the princes.
Sheth: He shall subdue all that resist: for of Sheth came Noah, and of Noah all the world.
first of the nations: The Amalekites first made war against Israel, Nu 14:45.
puttest thy nest in a rock: Make yourself as strong as you can.
who shall live when God doeth: Some read, Oh who shall not perish when the enemy (that is, Antichrist) shall set himself up as God?
he also shall perish for ever: Meaning, Eber, or the Jews for rebelling against God.
